The 3-Number Code Behind 500 Million Years of Evolution

In 1966, paleontologist David Raup proved that every shell, horn, and tusk across hundreds of millions of years of animal evolution can be generated using just three mathematical parameters. Discover the secret blueprint of nature's design. 🐚📐 What other hidden mathematical patterns have you noticed in nature?
